turns.question: It's the end of 7 October 2026. How many customers who signed up in 2026 have never placed an order?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for customers who never ordered, so I can't give that figure; the closest are Signups (20 customers who signed up from 2026-01-01 to 2026-10-07) and Active customers (4 of the 2026 signups with at least one non-cancelled order in that period). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
